changelog: Major update - read the upgrade guide at noxcore.me/docs/nc-vehiclekeysv2/upgrading before replacing the resource. New: locksmith service tablet (new and spare keys, re-registration, GPS tracker and lock security installed by the mechanic), keyring panel, GPS tracking with a police GPS panel, key cloner, GPS jammer, tool wear with a tool dealer (random spots per server start), Config.KeyMode ('item' or 'hybrid'), chat commands for every target option, translatable panel texts. Lockpick, hotwire and window-smash minigames are built in: t3_lockpick and mgc are no longer needed. GTA's own window-smash break-in on parked cars is blocked. Changed: the Key Assignment and Security NPCs are replaced by the tablet, Reset Keys is now re-registration (7500), config options were reorganised (see the guide for the old-to-new table). New items: gpsjammer, keycloner, policetracker, gps_tracker, keyring (optional); security_upgrade is now the boat/aircraft lock kit and must not stack.
